notes.title: Update
notes.notes:
Hello 
I want to thanks everyone that is still playing this game for such a long time, as you can see I still want to develop this project and make it better and better. I release a big update today and I hope you all will like it.

:)

notes.title: New BIG update !
notes.notes:
ːsteamhappyːːsteamhappyː
It's been a long time since the last update.  Since the launch game has changed in a great way.  I hope that this version will appeal to you.

New heroes

An extended plot

Corrected errors

The new flying system

A new object to build

A new mystery

notes.title: Since now you can create whatever you want
notes.notes:
There are three new things:
ːsteamhappyː  - With this update, hero gets a book with which he can create whatever he likes. You can leave a message on Steam about what machines he should be able to build. In the next update, your ideas will be added to the game.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31378653/b3eabd120ea747e4068d1520d4993bc814950411.jpg[/img]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/31378653/52e8011eabdeca5b107e4daaebe6134797071e2b.jpg[/img]

ːsteamhappyː -  The game has been optimized. There are no problems with graphics on low quality settings. 

ːsteamhappyː- Now you can see the loading bar during the loading screen

notes.title: ! COMPETITION !
notes.notes:
ːsteamhappyːːsteamhappyːːsteamhappyːːsteamhappyː
          [b] 5 FREE GAMES TO WIN [/b]
Hi, the lastest update is a completely new system of machines building
For now, you can build only one machine that creates a battery.
And that's why I'm waiting for your ideas, describe how your machine would work, how much it would cost in the game
You will get a code for an interesting idea and the most interesting will be in the game
You can imagine whatever machine you like and it will be in this game ! ! !
just write about it
